name: io.github.izagood/avcs
title: AVCS
description: Agentic Version Control System — an AI-native VCS where intent, operation, evidence and decision are first-class objects; agents propose, validate and land changes through 36 MCP tools.

packageArguments.description: start the stdio MCP server (target repo = $AVCS_REPO, else the cwd)

environmentVariables.name: AVCS_REPO
environmentVariables.description: absolute path of the AVCS repo to serve; defaults to the client cwd
